narrative_purpose: The chapter's full-bleed atmospheric backdrop - a vast dim Pandoran vista the reader's long-form text floats over, setting a contemplative mood.
subject: An immense panoramic Pandoran wilderness seen from very far away and high up - a dark expanse of glowing forest canopy and a few distant suspended rock masses dissolving into deep haze toward the horizon. No single subject dominates; the scale is vast and quiet.
scene: Deep night under a faint bioluminescent glow. Layered mist drifts low across the canopy; the whole scene is dim and low-contrast, mostly dark, so overlaid text stays readable - light is sparse and atmospheric, not a bright focal burst.
camera: Ultra-wide establishing panorama, extreme depth, very high vantage looking out and slightly down across the whole landscape to a distant hazy horizon.
light: Very low-key moonless night; faint cool glow rising from scattered bioluminescent flora and mist; no strong highlights, deliberately underexposed and moody.
palette: Predominantly deep void blue and near-black, with restrained cyan and teal glows in the mist; almost no warm tones; overall dark and macro.
style: Cinematic matte-painting establishing shot, vast atmospheric depth, painterly photoreal.
detail_level: Soft and atmospheric throughout - no crisp foreground subject; detail dissolves into haze so the image reads as ambient backdrop, not a figure to study.
composition: Full-bleed, horizon low, immense calm sky filling most of the frame; visual weight spread evenly with no bright center, leaving the upper-middle dark for text overlay.
consistency_notes: Cyan-teal bioluminescent glow on deep void-blue matching the book's palette, but darker, wider, and more distant - a macro mood backdrop, not a close hero.
negative_prompt: no text, no logos, no people, no bright hotspot, no high contrast, no sharp foreground, no warm daylight, no oversaturation, no busy detail
